Welcome to the Companion Animal Travel Desk.

Small Pet Travel Basics

Traveling with a small pet on Aurelia Skyways can go smoothly when you plan ahead and keep the comfort of your animal in mind. Our team wants the trip to feel calm for you and safe for the pet, and we work with care from booking to arrival.

Before you travel, check that your carrier is sturdy, well ventilated, and easy to handle. The passenger coordinator can walk you through the steps that apply to your trip, and the welfare coordinator reviews comfort needs so the animal is not rushed or stressed. If you are preparing a dog for the cabin, keep in mind <<FACT F062>>. You should also note <<FACT F056>> so there are no surprises when you get to the airport.

Please keep the pet settled and ready for screening, and be sure the carrier stays closed except when security staff ask you to open it. The ground team moves carriers carefully between services, and prompt, respectful communication helps everyone stay on track. If you are flying with a bird, remember <<FACT F077>>. That kind of detail matters because younger animals may need a different plan, and we want to help you choose the safest option.

It is also a good idea to bring the basics your pet needs for a calm trip, such as familiar bedding and any required supplies allowed for travel. If you are unsure whether your animal is fit for the journey, contact the desk before departure so the staff can review your plans and guide you with care.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk and we will assist you with the next steps.
